basic_details.job_title: DDU Hospital Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 22 October 2026, reporting at 9:30 AM at the venue specified in the notice, for 9 Junior Resident posts on a contract basis at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital (DDU Hospital) under its 2026 recruitment. Applicants must possess an MBBS from an NMC recognized university/institute, be below 30 years as on date of Interview, and hold a valid DMC certificate at the time of Interview, while candidates with DMC acknowledgement will not be accepted and those appearing after 11:00 AM will not be considered. The notified pay is Level-10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500). E

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: For general candidates, the maximum age limit is below 30 years as on the date of Interview. 4% seats shall be reserved for physically handicapped persons as per the rules.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBBS from NMC (erstwhile MCI) recognized university/institute or equivalent degree. Foreign Graduate must have cleared FMG examination. Candidate must have completed one year rotatory internship/passed FMG examination on or after 23.10.2024 (i.e. 02 year before date of interview). Candidate must have valid DMC Certificate at the time of Interview.

qualification.details: Junior Resident: MBBS from NMC (erstwhile MCI) recognized university/institute or equivalent degree. Foreign Graduate must have cleared FMG examination. Candidate must have completed one year rotatory internship/passed FMG examination on or after 23.10.2024 (i.e. 02 year before date of interview). Candidate must have valid DMC Certificate at the time of Interview.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a Pay Scale as per Pay Matrix at Level-10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500), plus usual allowances admissible under the rules.

selection_process: Selection will be made through a walk-in interview conducted on 22 October 2026 at the designated venue for eligible candidates reporting between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM.
how_to_apply: Download the application form enclosed at the bottom of the official notification advertisement.
Print pages 3 to 5 of the notification containing the application form and checklist.
Fill out the prescribed Performa accurately with your personal and educational details.
Attach self-attested copies of all required testimonials, mark sheets, degree certificates, internship completion proof, and valid DMC certificate.
Affix passport size photographs on the application form.
Arrange your documents in the exact order specified in the checklist provided on page 3 of the notice.
Bring the filled form and original documents directly to the Seminar Hall (Ground Floor), Doctor's Hostel, DDUH, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64 on 22 October 2026 between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM.
important_instructions: No Application form will be provided at the time of interview. Candidates appearing after 11:00 AM will not be considered for Interview. Candidates must have original documents at the time of Interview. Candidate must have a valid DMC Certificate at the time of Interview; candidates with DMC acknowledgement will not be accepted. Appointment will be initially for a period of 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year on the basis of satisfactory work & conduct report from the concerned HOD and written request from the doctor concerned or till the regular appointment of JR. OBC/EWS certificates issued from Govt. of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates who will appear for interview. Selected candidates who accept the offer of appointment and join the hospital will not be given NOC of any kind for any purpose whatsoever before putting in at least 06 months of service.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DDU Hospital Junior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026, with a reserve day on 23 October 2026 in case the interview is not completed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM. Candidates appearing after 11:00 AM will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Seminar Hall (Ground Floor), Doctor's Hostel, DDU Hospital, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64.

faq.question: Q4. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 tentative vacancies for Junior Residents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an NMC (erstwhile MCI) recognized university/institute or equivalent degree, along with a completed one-year rotatory internship or passed FMG exam on or after 23 October 2024, and a valid DMC registration.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for general candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general candidates is below 30 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Level-10 pay (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500) plus usual allowances admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is a DMC acknowledgement slip accepted during the interview?
faq.answer: No, candidates must have a valid DMC certificate at the time of interview; candidates with DMC acknowledgement will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of appointment for this position?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year based on satisfactory work and conduct or until regular appointment of a JR.
